senses.sense_definition: To declare oneself disqualified from participating in a legal case due to a conflict of interest or lack of impartiality.

examples.text: The judge <w>recused</w> herself from the case because she had a personal connection to the defendant.
The prosecutor decided to <w>recuse</w> himself to avoid any appearance of bias during the trial.

senses.sense_definition: To formally object to a judge or juror participating in a case due to a potential conflict of interest.

examples.text: The defense attorney moved to <w>recuse</w> the juror after discovering a business relationship with the plaintiff.
The legal team sought to <w>recuse</w> the presiding judge due to his public comments about the case.
